'''Joshua Andersen''' (also written '''Joshua Anderson''') won the [[1997 Tatooine Regionals (Denver)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="nf97tat">[http://www.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/tatooinequalifier.html The Wild Wild West: Stranger Takes Star Wars CCG Denver Title], Rich Loftus, Decipher NewsFlash (6 June 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970607091955/http://www.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/tatooinequalifier.html Internet Archive]</ref>
